case_classification.short_description: Loan Amortization Schedule for an Annuity Loan

ai_time_estimate_reasoning: The task requires setting up a loan amortization schedule with custom compounding (semi-monthly compounding with semi-annual payments). An expert modeler will need to first correctly calculate the effective periodic interest rate using compounding conversion formulas and verify that the final balance at period 60 matches the target $255,000 balloon payment. They must then build the 60-period amortization table, generate correct dates using EDATE, and create a lookup system (or SUMIFS for the yearly questions) to automatically populate the 25 questions, ensuring high precision and no hardcoded values.
